# Chord Sequence

> Chord Sequence (chordsequence.com) is a free online chord progression builder for songwriters, producers, and music students. Build progressions with drag-and-drop, hear them with real-time playback across 13+ rhythm styles, export as WAV, and explore ready-made genre libraries — no account or DAW required.

## Core Tool
- [Chord Progression Builder](https://chordsequence.com/): The main app. Drag-and-drop chord editor with real-time playback, 37 chord types, key transposer, and WAV export. Free, no account required, works in any browser.

## Learn: Music Theory & Chord Progressions
- [What is a Chord Progression?](https://chordsequence.com/learn/what-is-a-chord-progression/): Beginner's complete guide — definitions, Roman numeral system, common progressions, and how emotion maps to harmony.
- [Chord Progressions for Beginners](https://chordsequence.com/learn/chord-progressions-for-beginners/): The 4 chords every songwriter needs — I–V–vi–IV, 12-bar blues, and how to get started writing songs.
- [Jazz Chord Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/learn/jazz-chord-progressions/): Complete guide to ii–V–I, jazz blues, bossa nova, turnarounds, and modal jazz with interactive players.
- [Circle of Fifths Explained](https://chordsequence.com/learn/circle-of-fifths-explained/): How to use the circle of fifths for songwriting, understanding key relationships, and modulation.
- [How to Transpose Chords](https://chordsequence.com/learn/how-to-transpose-chords/): Complete transposition guide with semitone reference chart and worked examples.
- [Music Theory Basics for Songwriters](https://chordsequence.com/learn/music-theory-basics-for-songwriters/): Intervals, scales, and diatonic chords — the minimum theory needed to write songs.

## Ready-Made Progression Libraries
- [Jazz Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/jazz/): Curated jazz chord progressions — ii–V–I, turnarounds, tritone substitutions — ready to play and edit.
- [Pop Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/pop/): The most common pop chord progressions with interactive playback. I–V–vi–IV, vi–IV–I–V, and more.
- [Lo-Fi / Chill Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/lo-fi/): Lo-fi chord progressions with extended chords for relaxed, laid-back vibes.
- [Neo Soul Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/neo-soul/): Neo soul harmony with maj7, min9, and dominant 13th chords.
- [EDM Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/edm/): Electronic dance music chord progressions for house, trance, and synth-based music.
- [Gospel / Worship Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/worship/): Gospel chord progressions for worship music and contemporary Christian music.
- [Happy Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/happy/): Upbeat, major-key chord progressions that convey joy and energy.
- [Sad Progressions](https://chordsequence.com/progressions/sad/): Minor-key and melancholic chord progressions for emotional songwriting.

## Tools
- [Chord Transposer](https://chordsequence.com/tools/chord-transposer/): Instantly transpose any chord or progression to a different key. Includes semitone reference chart and worked examples.
- [Circle of Fifths](https://chordsequence.com/tools/circle-of-fifths/): Interactive circle of fifths for navigating key relationships.
- [Key Detector](https://chordsequence.com/tools/key-detector/): Detect the key of any chord progression.

## About
- [About Chord Sequence](https://chordsequence.com/about/): About the tool and its creator.
- [Elías Corsino Saldaña](https://chordsequence.com/about/elias-corsino/): Creator of Chord Sequence — Musician & Software Developer from the Dominican Republic. Plays piano, bass, guitar, and drums. Started learning music at age 12.

## Key Facts
- 100% free, no account required
- Works in-browser, no download or DAW needed
- 37 chord types supported (major, minor, 7th, maj7, min7, diminished, augmented, suspended, and more)
- 13+ rhythm styles with real audio samples (pop, rock, jazz, lo-fi, worship, Latin, and more)
- WAV export for use in any DAW (Ableton, Logic, GarageBand, FL Studio)
- Chord progressions stored in browser — private, no server uploads
- Works offline after first load
